directive.quote: finish the source-repo-a port so the repo can be retired and renamed source-repo-a-completely-ported

targets.baseline_commit_message: compare-voice-and-music-models: the narration voice A/B take makers, take measure and A/B render move byte for byte from source-repo-a

preserve: each unit is one generation; a unit never splits a sentence
pronunciation is misaki [word](/IPA/) markup in the unit text, with the G2P language of the voice accent (lang_of)
a silence the model makes inside a unit is kept but cut to inner_most (one cap, or one per unit) from its middle; only silent samples are removed
each unit's own edge silence below edge_db is trimmed (20 ms kept before, 40 ms after) and units are joined by the pause_after silences; speech is never stretched
allowed_deltas: the model, speed, sample rate and edge level are the person's settings over DEFAULTS (list:settings, read by tools/settings)
refusals with what to change replace the asserts; a last {result}/{error} line is printed
the module is also the shared definition of settings, speech to text and refusals for the other voice A/B scripts, and prints the settings' takes and commands for render_takes.sh
banned_substitutions: time-stretching or slowing a word to fix how it sounds
a second definition of units, pauses or silence handling beside this module
_lines: The source is the file's lines named, in parts: the lines between them name the film's narrator and stay behind (their job is the line data and settings now).
